# TikTok Growth System

30-day organic TikTok content playbook: a posting plan, 30 hook scripts, a bio + CTA pack, and a trend-jacking playbook. Built for the buyer's niche, on-camera comfort, and hours per week.

## Key pages

- / — landing page with free teaser (5 hook scripts) and $27 checkout
- /success.html — post-Stripe confirmation; polls payment status, links to the playbook
- /deliverable.html — the buyer's private playbook page (token-gated), with Download-PDF via print

## API

- POST /api/tiktok/teaser — free: { niche, on_camera, hours_per_week } → 5 hook scripts. KV rate-limited per IP.
- POST /api/tiktok/generate — paid: { order_token, inputs } → full playbook manifest. Gated on tiktokgrowth_orders.access_token. Idempotent.
- GET /api/tiktok/deliverable?token= — token-gated playbook manifest JSON.

## Compliance

Original-content methods only. No bots, no automation, no income or follower promises, no hacks. Banned-copy enforcement runs in three layers: prompt blocks, validator repair nudges, and a last-resort sanitizer (see functions/api/tiktok/_lib/claims.js).

## Pricing

$27 one-time via Stripe, through the centralized https://mehyar.us/api/pay/checkout. 7-day redo-or-refund.
